title: Qalam and Code
subtitle: The main objective of this event was to bring together creativity, quick thinking, and high energy in one evening, blending the art of expression ("Qalam" — the pen) with the spirit of fun competition.
description:
Event: Qalam and Code 
 Objective of the Event: The event was open to all students and was hosted by two senior members of the chapter. The evening opened with the Hook Step Dance Challenge, where participants took the stage to show off their moves and energy. This was followed by the Pair Challenge, a fast-paced word-guessing activity in which one member of each pair acted out or described a word, largely drawn from popular memes and current trends, displayed on the screen for the audience to see, while their partner tried to guess it correctly within time. Red Bull cans were distributed to the entire audience throughout the event and winners of each challenge were additionally rewarded with Red Bull, keeping the energy high from start to finish.
location: Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi
highlights: Encouraged participants to apply their programming knowledge in a competitive environment.
Provided a platform for students to showcase their coding skills and creativity.
